operators.name: group_norm_forward
semantics: Applies GroupNorm with num_groups=3, num_channels=3 (each channel is a separate group).
Computes mean and biased variance over each channel's H*W elements (N*H*W per group since group size=1, effectively instance norm per channel).
Normalizes x: y = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps).
Applies affine transformation: out = weight[c] * y + bias[c].
Weight and bias are CUDA tensors moved to same device as x or assumed already on GPU by launcher; model forward ensures they are on CUDA.
Follows nn.GroupNorm reference semantics with same eps=1e-5, affine=True, bias=True.
GroupNorm output after normalization and affine transform.
